partition.parent_certificate_rule: Each parent-window covers one exact spatial b-chunk and one disjoint row-index window; each row in the window is exactly one computed row certificate or an exact implicit zero.
partition.c_shard_rule: For every unfinished exact row, partition c=0..h into consecutive disjoint width-8 ranges; the final range may be shorter. Each (row,c-range) certificate is exact and independently reusable.
partition.c_shard_artifact_strategy: Store c-shard certificate files inside the existing 96 parent-window artifacts; do not create per-c-shard Actions artifacts.

resume_contract.c_shard_certificate: exact identity + source locks + canonical digest + HPADJ22 baseline + joint survivors + improvement + zero MAIN credit
resume_contract.c_shard_validation: schema + canonical + parent/row/c-range identity + current worker/helper/source locks + exact c coverage + joint<=baseline
resume_contract.row_reconstruction: Require the complete ordered c-range partition with gaps=0 and overlaps=0, then integer-sum all additive result fields into the existing ROW certificate schema.
resume_contract.representative_exact_equivalence: Cold verifier computes an actual FULL178 row with at least two c-shards both monolithically and by c-shard union and requires identical exact result dictionaries.
resume_contract.recovery: For each parent-window use generation16 first. If unavailable, fall back to generation15, then generation14, then the generation10 b4c0w1 special seed; inject source-locked retained local complete rows; validate complete rows first, then validate c-shards of unfinished rows, and compute only missing exact c-shards.

resume_contract.recovery_snapshot_inventory: All 96 parent-window identities are classified COMPLETE/PARTIAL/MISSING/REJECTED; validated row and c-shard identities plus canonical commitments are recorded; invalid files are surfaced instead of aborting snapshot creation.
resume_contract.aggregate_gate: Aggregate remains blocked unless the recovery inventory reports all 96 parent windows COMPLETE with validated complete manifests and no rejected carry.
resume_contract.retained_local_row_conflict_rule: If an artifact carry already contains the same retained row identity, require exact baseline/joint/improvement equality before replacing it with the source-locked retained certificate; any conflict fails closed.
